title: Answer: conscious processing that bypasses layer 5 neurons

statements.text: The theory would be refuted by conscious content arising from cortical processing that does not reach layer 5 neurons and the nonspecific thalamus, or by preserved consciousness while the apical and basal compartments stay decoupled.

sources.quote: This perspective makes one quite specific prediction: cortical processing that does not include L5p neurons will be unconscious.
